title: Emergency stop body
description: A city-wide emergency stop with a sunset (register row GV6; spec-delta S1420). While it stands, no NEW commitment is made in the society: no intent, offer, proposal, contract, bond, Mandate or purchase of a non-essential service is accepted (`city_stopped`, naming the stop, its reason and its end). Work already under way finishes: deliveries, acceptances, settlements, Court appeals, refunds, claims and essential or remedial services go on. `stop` is signed by the operator and countersigned by the owner, must end within 72 hours of the record, and cannot start while another stop is live; it ends by itself at `until`, so nothing stays stopped because someone forgot. `lift` ends a stop early (the operator or the owner). Every stop and lift is public. Chain: none (prev is null).
